name: wakewake-e2e
description: WakeWake E2E tests (Playwright + ky + Docker Compose, specs/testing/e2e.md)

scripts.pretest: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --profile mail --profile bemfa up -d --build && docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml --profile agent build agent && until curl -sfk https://localhost:8443/api/v1/health; do sleep 2; done
